_comment: SHARED TEMPLATE — do not put personal paths here. Create your own machine-specific config (e.g., D:/engines.local.json) and pass it to tools via --config. This file documents the config schema with placeholder values.
_instructions: Copy this structure to your local config file and replace every <placeholder> with your machine's real paths. Tools read the config passed via --config; they never auto-discover this template.

engines._comment_engine: Map of engine version → installation. 'root' is the directory CONTAINING the Engine/ subfolder. 'type' is 'source' (built from source) or 'binary' (Epic official build). Add/remove versions freely — only the versions you list are buildable.

defaults._comment_defaults: Default paths used by build tools when the matching --flag is not given.
defaults._comment_plugin_path: Directory CONTAINING <PluginName>/<PluginName>.uplugin. Can be the plugin's parent dir or the build repo.
defaults._comment_output_path: Root of the build output tree; binaries land in {output}/{platform}/{engine_version}/{plugin_name}/.

dependencies._comment_dependencies: Map of embedded dependency name → its source directory. The AI reads this to know where to copy dependency code from when embedding (see SKILL.md §4).

upstream._comment_upstream: The plugin's pure upstream source repo, as configured in the build repo's git remotes.

_comment_plugin_version: One-shot version bump for this adaptation run, written into the .uplugin VersionName at the first (highest) version boundary commit. Leave empty normally; set it (e.g. "4.1.0") before adapting, clear it again after the full adaptation completes. Format: full semantic version (major.minor.patch). Major is explicit, minor+1 for new-engine adaptation, patch+1 for bugfix adaptation.

logs._comment_logs: Where build/operation logs are written for human review. Build logs: {dir}/build/{plugin}_{version}_{timestamp}.log. Operation log (append): {dir}/operation/{plugin}_{version}.log.
